from collections import Counter

# Pagination with empty-page guard
recs = []
page = 0
while True:
    page_items = apis.spotify.show_recommendations(access_token=token, page_index=page)
    if not page_items:
        break
    recs.extend(page_items)
    page += 1

# Aggregate artist IDs, ignoring songs without artists
artist_ids = []
for rec in recs:
    try:
        song = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=rec.song_id)
        artist_ids.extend(artist.id for artist in song.artists)
    except Exception:
        continue

if not artist_ids:
    apis.supervisor.complete_task(answer=None, status="failure")
else:
    counts = Counter(artist_ids)
    # For least: counts.most_common()[-1][0]
    target_id = counts.most_common()[0][0]
    apis.supervisor.complete_task(
        answer=apis.spotify.show_artist(artist_id=target_id).name,
        status="success"
    )
